To be used in Appearances lists when an article subject has been [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into being present in a previously released piece of media.

<code><nowiki>{{1str|[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] and [[Bloodline (audiobook)|''Bloodline'' audiobook]]}}</nowiki></code>

results in

{{1str|[[Bloodline (novel)|''Bloodline'']] and [[Bloodline (audiobook)|''Bloodline'' audiobook]]}}
